newsitem.title: USA: Brent advances in late day U.S. paper trading.
newsitem.headline: Brent advances in late day U.S. paper trading.

text.p: Prices of world benchmark North Sea Brent crude oil rose in late day U.S. paper trade, with one Wall Street player picking up four cargoes at $18.30 a barrel, or nine cents above its earlier close, traders said.
A number of partial cargoes were done at $18.20, $18.21, $18.22, $18.23, $18.25 and $18.27, they said.
Also, one cargo worth of July/August spread trades was done at minus 22 cents between two Wall Street players.
